items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: It was a seven piece band, but it had a guy in there that I'm sure you know. You're talking about names, and he's still playin' trumpet. He looks like Louis -- Teddy Buckner.

ctx.x: Was that a big band, or a small group?

It was a seven piece band, but it had a guy in there that I'm sure you know. You're talking about names, and he's still playin' trumpet. He looks like Louis -- Teddy Buckner. He's still in L.A. with his own group, and I had a little saxophone player. His original name was Curt Kirk Bradford, but he goes by the name now of Mustafa Hashim. But he was the first alto player after Jimmie Lunce Ford. Willie Smith with the great (unintelligible). Yeah. Curt Bradford. Excellent saxophonist. He was in the pit band, and we…
